attachments.label: Ảnh quảng cáo
attachments.prompt: start the video from exactly this image — same person, product, outfit, background and on-image text

prompt: Animate the attached advertising image into a realistic vertical 9:16 social media video.
Keep the person's face, body, outfit and the product (packaging, label, colors) exactly as in the image.
Natural, believable motion with a gentle camera push-in; bright commercial lighting; smooth and sharp.
Keep any text already printed on the image unchanged and readable; do not add new text, logos or watermarks.
